title: Get the publishing status of a TikTok post
content_data:
Use this endpoint to obtain the publishing status of a TikTok video post or photo post. ## Before you start Initiate a post publishing task using [/business/video/publish/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1762228496095234) or [/business/photo/publish/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1803630424390658) and obtain `share_id` from the response. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/publish/status/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by TikTok creators.
To obtain an access token, use [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1833997638479041).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | business_id {Required} | string | Application specific unique identifier for the TikTok account.

Pass the value of the `open_id` field returned in the response of [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1833997638479041) to this field.| | publish_id {Required} | string | Unique identifier for a post publishing task.

Pass the value of the `share_id` field returned in the response of [/business/video/publish/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1762228496095234) or [/business/photo/publish/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1803630424390658) to this field. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/publish/status/?business_id={{business_id}}&publish_id={{publish_id}}' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| status | string | The publishing status of the TikTok post.

Enum values:
  • `PROCESSING_DOWNLOAD`: The download of content from the URL is in progress. This status is only available when you publish the post using a file URL.
  • `PUBLISH_COMPLETE`: The post has passed moderation and has been successfully published.
  • `FAILED`: The publishing process failed due to an error.
  • `SEND_TO_USER_INBOX`: The draft post has been successfully uploaded and the system has sent a corresponding notification to creator's inbox.
| #| post_ids | string[] | Returned only when `status` is `PUBLISH_COMPLETE` and the posts are publicly viewable.

The unique identifiers for the published TikTok posts.

Note:

  • Post IDs require up to three minutes of processing time. If post IDs are not immediately available in the initial response, retry after three minutes.
  • You can use the IDs as the filter field `video_ids` in [/business/video/list/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1762228421622786) to obtain the detailed metrics for the posts.
| #| reason | string | Returned only when `status` is `FAILED`.

The reason for the publishing failure.

Example: `frame_rate_check_failed`.

To find out the detailed description for each reason, see [Failure reasons](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810515090228226#item-link-Failure%20reasons). | ``` ### Example #### For a successfully published post ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "post_ids": [ "{{post_id}}" ], "status": "PUBLISH_COMPLETE" } } (/code) ``` #### For a failed post ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "reason": "frame_rate_check_failed", "status": "FAILED" } } (/code) ```
